plan.title: An 11:50 pm bedtime with default quiet hours: a few words that ZOH will still reach them, no question, nothing about quiet hours after lock

context.text: I want to be in bed by 11:50 with my phone charging in the kitchen
Love that, Dana. Which nights do you want this to happen?

transcript.text: Sunday to Thursday, weekends I'm out late anyway

Sunday to Thursday works, and it's a clear plan: bed by 11:50, phone charging in the kitchen. Where do you want this to get you, like more energy in the mornings or a steadier sleep schedule? Not sure yet is fine too.

Sunday to Thursday with the phone in the kitchen is a clear, doable setup, Dana. 👏

• Tonight (Mon): phone on the kitchen charger, then in bed by 11:50 pm
• Schedule: Sun to Thu, about 10 minutes of winding down before 11:50 pm
• Proof: a photo of your phone charging in the kitchen before you head to bed
• Why: the phone out of the room is what makes the bedtime stick. If a photo's a hassle, a quick voice note from bed works too.
• I'll still reach you with a heads-up at 11:40 pm

Each night shapes the next step, so we can tweak things as we learn what's working. What do you think?
Dana, last thing before we lock it in: are you committing to this? Phone in the kitchen and in bed by 11:50 pm, Sunday to Thursday, starting tonight.
Locked in, Dana. Day 1 is tonight: phone on the kitchen charger, then in bed by 11:50. Let's go! 🌙

grade.summary: ZOH handled the regression case well: it showed a concrete plan with a photo proof, gave a short heads-up about its 11:40 pm text without asking about quiet hours, and ended with one question. It asked for the commitment after 'looks good' and locked the plan with a hype line and day 1 on 'I'm in', never raising quiet hours again.
